segments.name: development and sale of our products and services
segments.description: Designs and sells a RAIN platform of endpoint ICs, reader ICs, reading systems and tag production systems, plus software and cloud services, through partners.
segments.evidence: We have one reportable and operating segment: the development and sale of our products and services.

revenueModel.text: We sell products and platform offerings to partners such as OEMs, tag service bureaus, systems integrators and resellers, rarely directly to end users.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products, individually or as a whole platform offering, primarily with or through our partner ecosystem.
